use default

cocktail_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let swapped mut = true

    while swapped do
        swapped = false

        for i in 0..values.count - 1 do
            if values[i] > values[i + 1] then
                (values[i], values[i + 1]) = (values[i + 1], values[i])

                swapped = true
            fi
        od

        if !swapped then
            break
        fi

        swapped = false

        let i mut = values.count - 2

        while i >= 0 do
            if values[i] > values[i + 1] then
                (values[i], values[i + 1]) = (values[i + 1], values[i])

                swapped = true
            fi

            i = i - 1
        od
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

cocktail_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

cocktail_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
